class.name: DiscordRPC
class.brief_description: Engine singleton for Discord Rich Presence.
class.description: [b]DiscordRPC[/b] is a singleton automatically registered by the DiscordRpcGodot GDExtension. It wraps the Discord Game SDK's Activity, Overlay, and Relationship managers to let a game show a Rich Presence activity in Discord, accept and send invites, and read the current user's friend list. Set [member app_id] first. Nothing else works until it's set to a valid Discord Application ID. Always refresh after changing the values with [method refresh]. [codeblock] func _ready(): app_id = 1234567890123456 details = "A demo activity" state = "Checkpoint 23/23" large_image = "game" large_image_text = "Try it now!" start_timestamp = int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()) refresh() [/codeblock]

method.name: accept_invite
method.description: Accepts a pending game invite from the user with the given Discord [param user_id].

method.name: accept_join_request
method.description: Accepts a join request from the user with the given Discord [param user_id]. Use this after receiving the [signal activity_join_request] signal, once you've decided the requester can join.

method.name: clear
method.description: Disables the current activity. A [param reset_values] of [code]true[/code] clears all values too, and the activity can no longer be restored with [method unclear]. Leave it [code]false[/code] to keep the values and be able to restore them later.

method.name: debug
method.description: Creates a throwaway test activity with hardcoded sample values, for verifying the plugin can talk to Discord at all. Not meant for real use in a game, use [member app_id] and the activity properties directly instead.

method.name: get_all_relationships
method.description: Returns every entry in the current user's relationship list as an [Array] of [Dictionary] entries, each shaped like the dictionary returned by [method get_current_user] plus a [code]"type"[/code] key ([code]"Friend"[/code], [code]"Blocked"[/code], [code]"PendingIncoming"[/code], [code]"PendingOutgoing"[/code], [code]"Implicit"[/code], or [code]"None"[/code]) and a [code]"presence"[/code] key describing what that user is currently doing. Wait for the [signal relationships_init] signal before calling this, the list may not be populated yet right after connecting.

method.name: get_current_user
method.description: Retrieves data about the currently connected Discord user account, as a read-only [Dictionary] with keys [code]"id"[/code] (int), [code]"username"[/code] (String, without the discriminator), [code]"discriminator"[/code] (int), [code]"is_bot"[/code] (bool), [code]"avatar"[/code] (String, the raw avatar hash, can be empty when the user has no avatar), and [code]"avatar_url"[/code] (String, generates a default avatar URL when no custom avatar exists). Results may not be accurate until the game fully establishes its connection to Discord.

method.name: get_is_discord_working
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the plugin currently has a live connection to the Discord client. Most other methods do nothing when this is [code]false[/code]. If it stays [code]false[/code], check that Discord is running and that [member app_id] is a valid application ID.

method.name: get_is_overlay_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the user has the Discord overlay enabled for this game.

method.name: get_is_overlay_locked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the Discord overlay is currently locked (input capture disabled).

method.name: get_result_int
method.description: Returns the raw integer value of the last Discord SDK result, where [code]0[/code] means [code]Ok[/code]. Mainly useful for debugging connection issues.

method.name: open_invite_overlay
method.description: Opens Discord's built-in invite overlay so the user can invite friends to join, or spectate if [param is_spectate] is [code]true[/code], their current activity.

method.name: open_server_invite_overlay
method.description: Opens Discord's overlay to let the user accept a server invite identified by [param invite_code].

method.name: refresh
method.description: Required after modifying the activity properties to reload the RPC. Always refresh after changing the values, changes are not sent to Discord automatically.

method.name: register_command
method.description: Registers the local command Discord should run when a friend clicks "Play Game" on this activity, e.g. the full path to this game's executable.

method.name: register_steam
method.description: Registers this game's Steam App ID with Discord, as an alternative to [method register_command] for the "Play Game" invite button when the game is distributed on Steam.

method.name: run_callbacks
method.description: Processes pending Discord SDK callbacks and events. This happens normally inside the bundled [code]DiscordRPCLoader[/code] autoload, so you normally don't need to call it yourself.

method.name: send_invite
method.description: Sends a game invite, or spectate invite if [param is_spectate] is [code]true[/code], to the user with the given Discord [param user_id], with [param message_content] as the accompanying message.

method.name: unclear
method.description: Reactivates a previously cleared activity, restoring it exactly as it was before [method clear] was called with [code]reset_values[/code] left [code]false[/code].

members.member: The Discord Application ID from the Discord Developer Portal, mandatory to be able to use anything in the plugin.
Current player count in the party shown in the activity.
The first text line visible in the Activity.
Unix timestamp used to enable a "remaining time" display in the activity.
Indicates an instanced context, like a specific match. Required for spectating to work.
Unique hash for join interactions. Generate this yourself, it's meant to be a payload only your own game understands.
Image key from Art Assets for the large image shown in the activity.
Maximum allowed players in the party shown in the activity.
Image key from Art Assets for the small image shown in the activity.
Unique hash for spectate interactions, separate from [member join_secret].
Unix timestamp used to enable an "elapsed time" display in the activity.
The second text line visible in the Activity.

signal.name: activity_join
signal.description: Triggered when joining via invite. Receives the [param join_secret] from the inviting party.

signal.name: activity_join_request
signal.description: Fires when a user requests to join via the Discord button. [param user_requesting] is shaped like [method get_current_user]'s return value. Call [method accept_join_request] to let them in.

signal.name: activity_spectate
signal.description: Triggered for spectate requests. Receives the [param spectate_secret] from the target match.

signal.name: overlay_toggle
signal.description: Emitted when the Discord overlay's lock state changes, matching what [method get_is_overlay_locked] would now return.

signal.name: relationships_init
signal.description: Emitted once the current user's relationship list has finished loading and [method get_all_relationships] is safe to call.

signal.name: updated_relationship
signal.description: Emitted whenever an entry in the current user's relationship list changes. [param relationship] has the same shape as one entry of [method get_all_relationships]'s return value.
